ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 40% high-intensity white/grey pixels and 60% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive mottling across both lobes. Left lobe features a large contiguous white patch at the distal tip with dense black high-frequency mottling toward the center. Right lobe contains large white regions with 5-7 distinct black circular rings and dense black pigmentation toward the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; multiple micro-peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes varying from 5 to 15 pixels from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the notch transitioning to a steep upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of approximately 6 dark circular ring-shaped scars on the white pigmented region of the right lobe; dense white/grey irregular textured clusters on both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions observed in the lower quadrant of the left lobe's mottled region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent heavy encrustations (bumpy, high-intensity texture) on the outer distal edges of both lobes; multiple circular scars on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black 'target' or 'ring' markings on the right lobe white field.
